title: Student V0.1 G3 R1 — independent Wave 2 review after repaired JOB06
purpose: Perform the new clean-context independent semantic review of the repaired JOB06 exact kit, then if it passes complete the deferred G3 Factory/compatibility/overlap review and freeze exact non-repairing JOB08 Fan-in B inputs.
invariants: G3 R1 is a review gate, not an implementation or repair job.
G3 R1 starts from the repaired-product evidence head and does not inherit the historical G3 branch or repaired JOB06 author branch.

Before the new semantic review is committed, reviewer context may contain only exact source bytes, exact learner brief, exact repaired candidate, exact repaired Factory context and public reviewer/factory/schema authorities.

Before semantic-review freeze, the reviewer must not read the historical G3 semantic review/evidence, JOB06/JOB06-R1 author audit, provenance, pedagogical-quality report, validation report, qualification conclusions, author scratchpad or active author conversation/context.
The repaired JOB06 semantic review is a full fresh review of all six required dimensions; it is not a delta-only confirmation of the repair.

No main merge, release promotion or real-student use is authorized.

adversarialTests: Reading historical G3 findings or repaired JOB06 author conclusions before the new semantic review is frozen invalidates the clean-review claim and must HOLD G3 R1.
A delta-only review that checks only the previously repaired items is invalid; all six semantic dimensions and the complete repaired candidate must be reviewed.
Semantic PASS may not be inferred from canonical/quality PASS.
Factory PASS may not be inferred from semantic PASS; the deterministic gate must execute on exact bytes.
Using JOB06 R1 author provenance as semantic source evidence before review freeze is forbidden.
Using the generated JOB07 R2 qualification kit instead of the exact repaired JOB06 showcase does not prove Wave 2 mutual compatibility.
Testing source-tree Learn-it instead of the extracted exact package is insufficient for package compatibility PASS.
JOB05 and JOB07 workflow modifications must not be blindly cherry-picked or merged at G3 R1.
A same-path payload conflict across accepted role outputs blocks Fan-in B input freeze.
A compatibility defect returns HOLD and is not repaired from G3 R1 scope.
G3 R1 PASS does not authorize JOB09 or real students.
nonGoals: Repairing product, QA, showcase, packaging, schema, authoring or workflow code.
Running human/student readiness or real students.
independentReview: The semantic reviewer phase is isolated from historical G3 findings and all JOB06 author-side conclusions until its review JSON is committed.
The repaired candidate is reviewed in full, not only for the previously repaired dimension.
Factory binding and cross-output compatibility are challenged only after the independent semantic verdict is durably frozen.
G3 R1 performs no repair; any defect is returned as HOLD to the owning role or Control Room.
rollback: Close the G3 R1 PR and delete student-v01/g3-wave2-review-r1. Repaired product, JOB05 R1, JOB06 R1, JOB07 R2 and historical G3 evidence remain unchanged.
